statement: Before merging several approved PRs, check each one against any open PR whose records claim its merged code equals a measured candidate. A clean merge between two PRs is not enough. Cejel #572's changelogs said the merged tree differed from its preregistered candidate only outside the scan path. Then #571, approved separately, merged first and changed the same scan-path file. #572 now conflicted, its equivalence claim was false for the code that would merge, and its experiment measured code that would never ship. Recovering took a merge of main into the branch, conflict resolution that kept both behaviours, and a third preregistered paired run. Rules: list the PRs whose records bind them to a measured commit; before merging any other PR, check whether it touches their scan path; if it does, sequence it, or plan the remeasurement before merging.
